summary: This piece profiles local entrepreneurs who have been reinvesting profits into their neighborhoods since September 2023, shifting from corporate social responsibility to personal, grassroots philanthropy. It highlights James McKinsey (environment), Eva Torres (food and health), Rajiv Singh (education), and Lina Kim and Javier Rojas (local artisans and economy). It argues that strong communities underpin thriving businesses and that this reflects a renaissance in business philosophy.
one_line: Local entrepreneurs since September 2023 are reinvesting profits in environment, education, health and local economies through grassroots philanthropy.
key_facts: The stories of local entrepreneurs giving back have unfurled since September 2023, with a shift in community focus emerging in fall 2023.
James McKinsey is founder of 'Green Futures Tech' and sees success as how profits can benefit the environment and society, not just the bottom line.
McKinsey and other entrepreneurs invest in local projects such as youth innovation camps and scholarship funds for local schools.
Eva Torres, CEO of 'Nourish Nutrition Inc.', decided in early 2024 to tackle food insecurity after seeing long queues at a local food bank.
'Nourish Nutrition' evolved from a company donation into an ongoing partnership providing monthly supplies of wholesome food to those in need.

Rajiv Singh launched the digital learning platform 'EduTech Connect', inspired by his own educational struggles, and funnels a significant portion of company profits into tech-based learning programs.
Singh's programs are implemented in numerous local schools, giving children educational tools at no cost, and include free coding workshops.
Lina Kim and Javier Rojas co-founded 'Artisanal Home', a marketplace for locally crafted home goods that also runs workshops and mentorship programs for aspiring artisans.
McKinsey launched 'The Green Pledge', a commitment by local businesses to reduce their carbon footprint and integrate sustainable practices.
'Green Futures Tech' collaborates with local environmental groups to fund cleanups and conservation projects.
Torres's 'Nourishment for All' campaign, an arm of 'Nourish Nutrition Inc.', offers free monthly health screenings, nutrition workshops, and fitness classes.
Torres has helped found community gardens and support urban agriculture projects, giving residents access to fresh produce.
